description: This file contains the React component 'IngestionClient', which provides a user interface for uploading documents related to different categories ('resume', 'job_description', 'performance_review'), managing uploaded files, and orchestrating the process of building a persona through API calls. It also includes auxiliary components and utility functions for file handling and UI interactions.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Converts a number of bytes into a human-readable string with units (B, KB, MB, GB).

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Extracts and returns the file extension label from a filename.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a random string ID for uploaded files.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for a given upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Returns a title string for upload interface associated with a category.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns the color accent associated with a given upload category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns the string of accepted file types for uploads.

methods.name: UploadCard
methods.description: React component allowing users to upload files via click or drag-and-drop, styled according to category.

methods.name: LinkedInConnect
methods.description: React component providing UI controls for connecting to LinkedIn, with toggle state.
